title: The Advantage of Spatial Reasoning No Longer Exists! OpenAI Executive Explicitly States That the Astra Model Has Filled the Last Human Shortcoming AGI Era Is Really Here
excerpt: In the ongoing wave of artificial intelligence advancement, the fundamental cognitive advantages that humans once took pride in are being quietly eroded. Boris
content_html:
In the ongoing wave of artificial intelligence advancement, the fundamental cognitive advantages that humans once took pride in are being quietly eroded. Boris Power, head of applied research at OpenAI, recently publicly stated on a social media platform that spatial reasoning was one of the few core advantages that humans had significantly over computers. However, with the official launch of the Astra model, this historical gap no longer exists.

This shocking conclusion is not baseless. Independent AI researcher @spicylemonade, after conducting a series of specialized spatial reasoning evaluations, exclaimed that Astra's performance in the tests was nothing short of perfect, having fully "mastered" all the questions. The researcher admitted that in the past, large language models (LLMs) often made frequent errors when handling such specific questions, but Astra's perfect performance means that the visual capabilities of large models have been completely resolved.

As OpenAI's latest flagship product, GPT-6 Astra has also attracted significant attention at its release time. It has been about a year since the previous popular GPT-5 model series was released, and about two months since the most recent GPT-5.6 upgrade. OpenAI officially described it as a historic leap in professional work and extremely rarely praised it as "the smartest and best-aligned model in the world."

In practical applications, Astra has demonstrated an extremely terrifying all-around automation potential. According to the official introduction, whether it's daily tasks like filling out tables, adjusting complex document formats, scheduling appointments, or operating various software, any task that a human can perform on a computer, Astra can quickly take care of. In response to this groundbreaking product launch, OpenAI's president Brockman confidently said, "Welcome to the AGI era." With the arrival of Astra, the boundaries of human-machine collaboration are being pushed to an unprecedented new height.
